final: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT p.ID FROM Patient p INNER JOIN (SELECT ID, MIN(`Examination Date`) as first_exam_date FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID) first_exam ON p.ID = first_exam.ID WHERE p.`First Date` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%Y', first_exam.first_exam_date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1)
